why: In the upper half of the domino the dots go up by 2 each time: 1, 3, 5, 7. In the lower half they go down by 1: 5, 4, 3, 2. So the missing domino has 5 dots on top and 3 dots below: option 5. Options 1 to 4 have the wrong number of dots on top or below.
trick: In domino series, count the dots in each half separately and look for +1, +2 or -1 steps.
note: The book key prints 4 (6 on top, 1 below), which does not fit the counting rule. Answer set to 5 by counting the dots.
